cues.caption: Chapter 5 · the last one in Unit 1!
cues.text: Hi champ! Welcome to Chapter five, the last chapter of Unit one!

cues.caption: Computers · Binary · Devices · Websites
cues.text: You already know what a computer is, how it thinks, its devices, and how websites talk.

cues.caption: Chapter 5 · Being Safe Online
cues.text: Today's big one: Being Safe Online!

cues.caption: 3 super safety rules
cues.text: You'll learn three super rules that protect you, just like a shield.

cues.caption: "Hi! I'm 10 too. Want to be friends?"
cues.text: Imagine you're playing a game online, and a message pops up: Hi! I'm ten too. Want to be friends?

cues.caption: Can you see who is really typing?
cues.text: Quick question. Can you see who is really typing? Think!

cues.caption: Online, anyone can pretend to be anyone
cues.text: Nope! Online, anyone can pretend to be anyone. It could be a kid, or a grown-up stranger.

cues.caption: Smart champs follow 3 rules
cues.text: That's why smart champs follow three safety rules. Let's go!

cues.caption: Rule 1: Private info stays private
cues.text: Rule one: private info stays private.

cues.caption: Full name · School · Home address · Phone number
cues.text: Private info means your full name, your school, your home address, and your phone number.

cues.caption: Together, they make a map to your door!
cues.text: One piece looks small. But put them together, and it's like a map that leads a stranger straight to your door!

cues.caption: OK to share: favourite colour, nickname, drawing
cues.text: So what can you share? Your favourite colour, a game nickname, or your drawing. Totally fine!

cues.caption: Say it: Private stays private!
cues.text: Say it with me: private stays private!

cues.caption: Game: Safe or unsafe?
cues.text: Game time! Safe post, or unsafe post? Answer fast!

cues.caption: Post 1: "I love mango ice cream!"
cues.text: Post one: I love mango ice cream!

cues.caption: SAFE! Anyone can know that
cues.text: Safe! Everybody can know that.

cues.caption: Post 2: name + school + street
cues.text: Post two: Hi, I'm Riya from Green Park School, and I live on Rose Street!

cues.caption: UNSAFE! That's a map to Riya's door
cues.text: Unsafe! Name, school and street, all together. That's the map again!

cues.caption: Post 3: "Look at my new drawing!"
cues.text: Post three: a photo of my new drawing.

cues.caption: SAFE! (no school badge or house number)
cues.text: Safe! Just don't show your school badge or house number in the picture.

cues.caption: Rule 2: Your password is a secret key
cues.text: Rule two: your password is a secret key.

cues.caption: It locks your games and accounts
cues.text: It locks your games and accounts, just like a key locks your home.

cues.caption: Secret, even from friends. Only parents know.
cues.text: Keep it secret from everyone, even your best friend! Only your mum and dad can know it.

cues.caption: Weak: 1234 or your name
cues.text: A weak password is easy to guess, like one two three four, or your own name.

cues.caption: Strong: long + words + numbers + symbols
cues.text: A strong one is long and mixed up, with words, numbers and symbols. Like Tiger, Jumps, seven, Mango!

cues.caption: Make your OWN. Never copy one from a screen.
cues.text: Tip: make your own. Never copy the one on the screen!

cues.caption: Which is stronger? abc123 or BlueKite!Runs42
cues.text: Your turn! Which is stronger: a b c one two three, or Blue Kite Runs forty two?

cues.caption: B! Longer + mixed = harder to guess
cues.text: Blue Kite Runs forty two! It's longer and mixed up, so it's way harder to guess.

cues.caption: Rule 3: Odd chat? Tell a trusted adult
cues.text: Rule three: if a chat feels odd, tell a trusted adult.

cues.caption: Red flags: photos, where you live, "don't tell"
cues.text: Odd means someone asks for photos, asks where you live, or says: don't tell your parents. Those are red flags!

cues.caption: Stop → Don't reply → Tell a grown-up
cues.text: Then do three things. Stop. Don't reply. Tell a grown-up you trust.

cues.caption: Mum or Dad · Teacher · Nani & Nana
cues.text: Who? Your mum or dad, your teacher, or your nani and nana.

cues.caption: You're never in trouble for telling
cues.text: And remember, you are never in trouble for telling. Telling is brave!

cues.caption: Practice check
cues.text: Practice check, just like the quiz!

cues.caption: A new online friend asks for your address…
cues.text: A new online friend asks for your home address. What do you do? A: tell them. B: tell only your street. Or C: don't share, and tell a trusted adult.

cues.caption: C: Don't share. Tell a trusted adult.
cues.text: C! Never share your address. Tell a grown-up right away. Well done!

cues.caption: Rule 1: Private info stays private
cues.text: Let's lock it in! Rule one: private info stays private.

cues.caption: Rule 2: Passwords are secret
cues.text: Rule two: passwords are secret, even from friends.

cues.caption: Rule 3: Stop, don't reply, tell an adult
cues.text: Rule three: odd chat? Stop, don't reply, and tell a trusted adult.

cues.caption: Never post: full name · school · home address
cues.text: And three things never to post: your full name, your school, and your home address.

cues.caption: Unit 1 complete!
cues.text: Chapter five done, and Unit one complete! You're a safe online champ!

cues.caption: Next: Quiz · Tap Finish
cues.text: Now a quick quiz. Tap Finish, and let's go!
